blocking_reason: NASA ASF Earthdata Cloud (https://nisar.asf.earthdatacloud.nasa.gov) requires NASA Earthdata Login OAuth2/URS credentials (EARTHDATA_USERNAME/EARTHDATA_PASSWORD, EARTHDATA_TOKEN, or ~/.netrc). None are present in the execution environment.

cmr_summary.blocker_explanation: 1) Matched same-track, same-frame pre-fire (Provisional CRID P05023, July/Sept 2026) and post-fire (Provisional CRID P05023 August/Oct 2026 + Validated CRID P05036 Oct 2026) NISAR L2 GCOV pairs were discovered in live NASA CMR across all 4 wildfire events. 2) Full-frame HDF5 downloads require 51.49 GB for the 4 primary pairs (exceeding the 12.53 GB local disk budget -> BLOCKED_STORAGE). 3) NASA Harmony OGC API Coverages supports server-side spatial + variable subsetting (reducing the 4 primary pairs to ~20.48 MB total, easily fitting local storage), but both Harmony and ASF Earthdata Cloud return HTTP 302/303 redirects to https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov/oauth/authorize and require NASA Earthdata Login credentials (~/.netrc or EARTHDATA_USERNAME/EARTHDATA_PASSWORD/EARTHDATA_TOKEN), which are not present in this environment -> BLOCKED_AUTH.
